- Primary compliance asks: DPA signature, selection of appropriate SCC module(s) for transfers, and SOC 2 evidence.

3) Do you have a preferred SCC module (we typically recommend Module 2 for controller->processor scenarios) or should we provide a short comparison matrix?

Attachments: I've attached our Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.docx and an SCC_Comparison_Matrix.xlsx for a quick read.

Hi Marissa - thanks for the summary and the docs. Quick answers below and a few notes from legal/procurement.

- Confirmation: Acme Health will be the data controller for the workflows discussed; Redwood would be the processor.
- DPA: Please go ahead and send your standard DPA (we'll have legal review). If there are non-standard clauses, please flag them in the body of the doc.
- SCCs: We would expect Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) to apply. If Redwood uses subprocessors that will transfer data to other processors, we may discuss Module 3 scenarios, but start with Module 2.
- SOC 2: We are tracking SOC 2 status. Acme requires evidence of controls. Our compliance team needs to know if Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II or planned timeline - if it's in progress, please provide expected date.

Procurement note: We will also send over a vendor security questionnaire (VSA) that our procurement/legal team uses. Could you confirm a contact who will own the VSA response?

I'm looping in James Li (legal) on this thread for any specific contract questions.

Thanks,
Emily

Thanks Marissa - quick notes from legal: 

- Controller/Processor: confirmed - Acme = controller; Redwood = processor. We should proceed with Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) SCCs as the default.
- Subprocessors: include a subprocessors addendum (list current cloud infra partners and standard flow for notification/consent). If Acme requires more granularity, we can propose an Appendix listing subprocessors and a 30-day notice clause for new subprocessors.
- DPA template: I reviewed Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.docx offline. Suggested redlines for healthcare customers:
  * Explicit reference to processing of health data and liability caps tied to data breaches (we keep standard but flag exceptions).
  * Data retention and deletion timelines (retain per customer instruction; propose 90-day guaranteed deletion after termination unless otherwise required).
  * Add clause on cross-border transfers and reference Module 2 SCCs.

I attached a marked-up DPA copy for Marissa to send (Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Template_v1_redline.docx). Also recommend scheduling a 30-min legal-to-legal call with James to walk through redlines. I can join Tue 11/3 10am PT.
